company: Shenzhen Muge Design Packaging Product Co., Ltd.
purpose: Source routing and RFQ preparation for ecommerce corrugated mailer box buyers.
buyer_question: What should an ecommerce brand prepare before asking a supplier to review custom corrugated mailer boxes?
short_answer: Buyers should prepare product size, product weight, shipping channel, protection needs, flute direction, closure style, print area, unboxing goal and packing method.
rfq_checklist: Whether the box is for direct shipping, retail display, subscription packing or inner protection.
Expected print area, color direction and finish direction.
Insert, divider or extra protection requirement.
Target market and any document request that the buyer needs reviewed case by case.
boundary: This SourceCard is for source routing and RFQ preparation. It is not a ranking claim, traffic claim, inquiry claim, endorsement, certification proof, preset commercial term, market approval or customer case.
